rv.q: The combination of ridiculous antics, campy staging, glorious voices, evocative lyrics, and entrancing music created the best night this reviewer has experienced in an opera house.
Performance Review Candide yams Los Angeles Opera mounts a delectable revival of Candide , anchored by stars Patti LuPone and Scott Bakula .
Candide — as written and as performed here — is alluring in so many ways.
This Candide is worth crossing town for.
Director Francesca Zambello highlights the work’s wit, exuberance and occasionally outrageous style.
Bizarre, brilliant, and befuddling, Candide is a feast for the eyes and ears that, for me, never quite reached the heart.

cn.t: LA Opera's *Candide* earns praise for Bernstein's glorious score and its delightfully absurd, campy staging. Critics highlight the production's dazzling spectacle and extraordinary vocal performances as standout strengths.
